description: The 14 Agile regions (GSP groups), each with well-known places in it - to place a home by its town. The regions are the local electricity networks' areas, not counties, so some places surprise (Milton Keynes and Coventry are in the East Midlands, Croydon in South East England, York in North East England). The surest way: the first two digits of the 13-digit MPAN on the home's electricity bill (`mpan_prefix`).
name: list_regions
title: Regions
